LanguageData.GunplayEnableSoundsDesc: Change fire and projectile impact sounds for some weapons. May require restart.
LanguageData.GunplayEnableWeaponAnimationsDesc: Animate weapons like miniguns and bows, and also animate weapon movement for pawns missing their targets.
LanguageData.GunplayEnableEffectsDesc: Show visual effects for projectiles impacting targets.
LanguageData.GunplayShowPuffsDesc: Show dust and smoke puffs spawned when projectiles impact surfaces.
LanguageData.GunplayParticleMultiplierDesc: Multiplies the number of particles spawned by impact effects. Default 100%, range 5% to 400%, in 5% steps.
LanguageData.GunplayProjectileSpeedDesc: Alter speed to specified percentage for all projectiles.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailWidthModeDesc: Determines how the base trail width is calculated.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailWidthModeDamage: Trail width: based on projectile damage
LanguageData.GunplayTrailWidthModeTexture: Trail width: based on projectile texture size
LanguageData.GunplayTrailWidthFactorDesc: Multiplies the calculated trail width. Default 100%, range 5% to 400%, in 5% steps.
LanguageData.GunplayUnarmedEffectsDesc: Give projectiles fired without a weapon (turret shots, scripted projectiles) bullet trails and impact sounds/effects.
LanguageData.GunplayUnarmedBulletsOnlyDesc: When enabled, only weapon-less projectiles dealing Bullet damage get these effects.
